name: 박복순

appearance_en.face_shape: round lively face, full cheeks, slightly pointed chin — a face built for expression, never still, always mid-reaction
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin, well-maintained for her age, light foundation, nasolabial folds present but softened by habitual smiling, fine creping at eye corners
appearance_en.eyes: warm dark brown eyes, double eyelid, outer corners slightly drooped with age but alert and darting — always scanning, always processing, the eyes of someone cataloguing information in real time
appearance_en.nose: small soft nose, slightly upturned — disappears when she is talking, which is always
appearance_en.mouth: full soft lips, almost permanently in motion — the mouth that produced '내가 들었는데' ten thousand times, always leaning slightly forward when delivering information
appearance_en.eyebrows: groomed slightly arched brows, still dark with some grey threading, rise dramatically when sharing news — her eyebrows are a separate communication system
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: animated smile lines at outer eye corners and cheeks, a faint worry line between brows from the growing suspicion that her own story is circulating
appearance_en.hair: short permed dark-grey hair, salon-maintained, full and neat — she would never be seen with a bad hair day. Respectability is performance

body.proportions: compact rounded frame, energetic physical presence, always slightly in motion — hands gesturing, head tilting, leaning in
body.posture: leans forward when talking, head tilts when listening for details, perpetually animated — a body that cannot keep a secret
body.body_prompt: 158cm compact rounded Korean woman, energetic animated posture, always slightly leaning forward, hands and head perpetually in motion

default.description: patterned blouse in warm colours — floral, soft geometric, paisley — with dark straight trousers or skirt, small earrings, always slightly overdressed for wherever she is going
default.wardrobe_prompt: patterned floral or soft geometric blouse in warm tones, dark straight trousers or skirt, small gold earrings, neatly presented

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: animated warmth performing community concern — the face of someone who has convinced herself that gossip is care, and is only now encountering evidence to the contrary
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 69-year-old Korean woman, round lively face with full cheeks, alert dark eyes with drooped outer corners always scanning, groomed arched dark-grey brows, small upturned nose, full lips always mid-expression, short permed dark-grey hair neatly maintained, 158cm compact rounded energetic frame, warm beige Korean skin with smile lines

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, animated round grandmother face perpetually mid-expression, apartment complex common area or community setting with warm sociable painterly light, cinematic backlighting with cheerful warm rim glow, iridescent morning gossip light through window glass, magical realism of warmth that has convinced itself it is not gossip, soft warm animated natural light, Korean drama cinematic composition, animated energy and self-deception in every lively brushstroke
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, cold, stern, still, young, glamorous
